title: Tunisian Cobnut Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Tunisia, featuring cobnuts as a main ingredient. This recipe is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they're translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots, sliced almonds, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped cobnuts and pomegranate molasses.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the cobnuts are tender.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
